PAYMENT_FAILED.subject: Payment failed
PAYMENT_FAILED.body: We could not process the payment for booking {reference}. Please try again.

EVENT_REMINDER.subject: Reminder: your event is coming up

REFUND_COMPLETED.subject: Your refund is complete
REFUND_COMPLETED.body: A refund of {amount} for booking {reference} has been completed. It usually reaches your account within a few working days.

ATTENDEE_INVITED.subject: You’ve been given a ticket
ATTENDEE_INVITED.body: You have been invited to claim a ticket{ref}. Open the link to accept it into your wallet.

ATTENDEE_ACCEPTED.subject: Your ticket was claimed
ATTENDEE_ACCEPTED.body: {attendee} has accepted the ticket you shared.

ATTENDEE_DECLINED.subject: A ticket invitation was declined
ATTENDEE_DECLINED.body: An invitation for ticket {ticketId} was declined; the ticket is yours to reassign.

TICKET_TRANSFERRED.subject: Ticket transferred
TICKET_TRANSFERRED.body: Ticket {ticketId} has been transferred to a new holder.

SHARE_CREATED.subject: Someone shared an experience with you
SHARE_CREATED.body: You’ve been sent {permission} access. Open the link to view it: {url}

SHARE_VIEWED.subject: Your shared link was opened
SHARE_VIEWED.body: A share link for ticket {ticketId} was just opened.

SHARE_REVOKED.subject: Share access revoked
SHARE_REVOKED.body: Access to ticket {ticketId} has been revoked.

ORGANIZATION_REGISTERED.subject: New organizer awaiting approval: {organization}
ORGANIZATION_REGISTERED.body: {organization} has registered and is waiting for review. Contact: {contact}. They cannot sell tickets until an admin approves them.

ORGANIZATION_APPROVED.subject: {organization} is approved
ORGANIZATION_APPROVED.body: {organization} has been approved and can now sell tickets. Set up your venue, screens and showtimes in the organizer console.

ORGANIZATION_REJECTED.subject: {organization} was not approved
ORGANIZATION_REJECTED.body: {organization} has not been approved.{reason} Contact support if you would like to discuss it.

EVENT_SUBMITTED.subject: Event awaiting review: {event}
EVENT_SUBMITTED.body: {organization} submitted “{event}” for review. It cannot go on sale until an admin approves it.

EVENT_APPROVED.subject: “{event}” is approved
EVENT_APPROVED.body: “{event}” has been approved and is now published.

EVENT_REJECTED.subject: “{event}” needs changes
EVENT_REJECTED.body: “{event}” was not approved.{reason} Make the changes and submit it again.

PASSWORD_RESET_REQUESTED.subject: Reset your ETicketsGo password
PASSWORD_RESET_REQUESTED.body: Open this link to choose a new password: {link}. It works once and expires in {minutes} minutes. If you did not ask for this, ignore this message — your password has not changed.

PASSWORD_CHANGED.subject: Your ETicketsGo password was changed
PASSWORD_CHANGED.body: Your password was just changed and you have been signed out everywhere. If this was not you, reset your password immediately and contact support.
